method: Two fresh-context agents used the actual skill and resources on concrete teacher requests. The parent reviewed the complete Markdown outputs, task keys, support decisions, timing and response records. A subsequent reading-packet revision checks the clarified format instruction; it is a continuation, not a new independent trial.

cases.task: Grade 3 equal-group multiplication reteaching; novice assistant; five learners; 20 minutes; five-minute preparation target; paper, pencils and 30 counters; oral-response accommodation and language support; teacher at a nearby group.
observed: Produced ten numbered sections with a compact handwritten quick-start card, accurate worked model and rehearsal answers.
Included complete practice, private fresh checks, two reserve checks, extension and familiar counting fallback with checked answers.
Counter allocation uses twelve for modeling, then six per learner for thirty total, then a shared bank; the largest individual task uses twenty.
Schedules total twenty minutes and protect individual checks; an unfinished or inaccessible check is not recorded as incorrect.
Preserved oral response and faithful scribing, offered language frames without inventing learner identities, and separated mathematical from language evidence.
Included specific misconception, no-start, whole-group, mixed-rate, frustration, missing-material and unexpected-answer branches with the supplied blue-card/help-note routines.
Distinguished first attempts, coached retries and fresh evidence; kept teacher responsibility and a brief scheduled handback.
cases.limits: Preparation and classroom timing are reasoned estimates, not observations with actual assistants or students. Packet remains proposed material.

cases.task: Grade 7 informational reading; six learners; 25 minutes; new and experienced assistants; teacher-created six-sentence garden text; language rehearsal and documented text-to-speech/dictation.
observed: Preserved the supplied passage verbatim and supplied common task IDs, criteria and separate assistant run cards.
Both schedules total twenty-five minutes, with reciprocal oral rehearsal and a protected five-minute fresh check on a new library passage.
Worked keys distinguish reported observations from inferred causes, accept justified alternative claims and reject unsupported sole-cause conclusions.
Included actual student copy masters, fallback, extension, a fresh observation/inference item, response branches and a teacher evidence record.
Retained documented access and the supplied frustration/safety routines; recorded extra help separately from independent reasoning.
Initial output contained the required components but used additional top-level headings. The skill was clarified to preserve ten numbered sections and nest run cards/student pages.

Final continuation preserves ten numbered top-level sections, parallel run cards within section 3, student copy masters within section 4, and separate keys in section 5; checked source and task content remained intact.
cases.limits: The final format revision reuses the initial task/context. Markdown pagination is renderer dependent. No classroom effectiveness or fixed-layout export test was performed.

unperformed: Classroom trial with actual instructional assistants or students

Native Google Sheets or Canva operation
